title: Exodus Bible Quiz - Chapter 36
description: Ten questions on Exodus 36: the overflowing offerings and the making of the tabernacle's curtains, coverings, boards and veil.

questions.text: How often did the people keep bringing free will offerings to Moses?
questions.explanation: They kept bringing free will offerings to him every morning.

questions.text: What did the wise men who did the work tell Moses?
questions.explanation: They said: "The people have brought much more than enough for the service of the work which Yahweh commanded to make."

answers.text: There was not enough gold for the ark
The people had brought much more than enough
The people had stopped bringing offerings

questions.text: What did Moses have proclaimed throughout the camp?
questions.explanation: Moses had it proclaimed: "Let neither man nor woman make anything else for the offering for the sanctuary." So the people were restrained from bringing.

answers.text: That everyone should bring a double offering
That only the rulers should bring offerings
That no one should make anything else for the offering
That the offerings should be brought only on the Sabbath day

questions.text: What was the length of each of the ten curtains of fine twined linen?
questions.explanation: The length of each curtain was twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits.

questions.text: How many curtains of goats' hair were made as a covering over the tabernacle?
questions.explanation: He made curtains of goats' hair for a covering over the tabernacle: eleven curtains.

questions.text: What were the fifty clasps that coupled the goats'-hair tent together made of?
questions.explanation: He made fifty clasps of bronze to couple the tent together, that it might be a unit.

questions.text: Besides the rams' skins dyed red, what covering was made for the tent?
questions.explanation: He made a covering for the tent of rams' skins dyed red, and a covering of sea cow hides above.

answers.text: A covering of sea cow hides

questions.text: What was the length of each board of the tabernacle?
questions.explanation: Ten cubits was the length of a board, and a cubit and a half the width of each board.

questions.text: What were the sockets under the boards of the south side made of?
questions.explanation: He made forty sockets of silver under the twenty boards, two sockets under each board for its two tenons.

questions.text: Whose work was the screen for the door of the tent?
questions.explanation: He made a screen for the door of the tent, of blue, purple, scarlet and fine twined linen, the work of an embroiderer.

answers.text: The work of a skilled stonecutter
